correctness.rationale: From the rational-Hartogs numerator series and the coefficient list, the degree-eight polynomial Q satisfies Q(s)=s^8 Q(1/s) with nonzero endpoint coefficients. Setting x=s+s^-1 gives a real quartic R on [-2,2]. Independently reconstructed coefficients from the finite ceiling formula for the first 28 odd n and checked its centered quartic; the full all-parameter proof rests on the displayed positive Bernstein coefficients separately for n=4k+1 and n=4k+3, valid for every k>=1. Positivity excludes unit-circle zeros; reciprocity yields precisely four interior roots. For nonzero interior zeta, m>n gives |zeta|^m<|zeta|^n<1, denominator nonzero and an explicit realizing pair, so a genuine kernel zero. Finite tests corroborate coefficient extraction, not universal positivity.
residual_risks: A separately written general coefficient-extraction proof was not produced; the all-n argument uses the exact displayed formulas and their algebraic Bernstein identities, not sampling alone. Individual roots/simplicity remain unspecified.
